text: ok. so this hides walls, but it only hides walls that have been made by claude, for example, i have made some walls, that have varying sizes of windows in them, and are double story. but they still exist when i do hide walls
resolution: Extended hide-walls to custom Studio walls. The first pass only flagged built-in box walls (catalog kind 'wall'); a Studio-modeled wall (double-storey, windowed) is cooked as kind:'prop' on the mesh substrate and ships through MESH_PROPS, so it stayed visible with hide on. Fix: a prop whose buildPlacement.pieceKind==='wall' is flagged on its MESH_PROPS instance (bumped the lump to v8 — a per-instance wall byte after the 20-byte header; worldGeometry encodes it, constructor.zig decodes it, older bakes read wall=false). The loader carries the flag onto baked_mesh_list and hides those mesh-prop node ranges in applyLiveMeshProps when hide-walls is on (same setBakedRangeVisible path the dirty-erase hide uses). Verified: city bake flags 306 cooked walls, native loader decodes v8 and renders GREEN; meshProps v8 byte-layout test + worldGeometry suite green; full ship clean. The user's own screenshot already confirmed the cooked-wall RENDER hides.
